messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated packet loss (10%+) and repeated BGP withdraws observed for prefixes to eu-west-2 via ProviderX. Auto-paging on-call.

oncall-alex: I'm on. Looking at net-telemetry now. @Priya can you pull BGP updates and bgpd logs from our eu-edge routers? Need timeframe + any reset patterns.

Priya: pulling /var/log/bgpd and recent RIB diffs from two edges (lon-edge, fra-edge). Will paste relevant tails.

Jordan: quick note: our flow logs show a spike in retransmits for customer flows on paths that transit ProviderX. Other upstreams look stable.

Samir: doing active probes to several eu-west hosts. traceroute shows loss starting at ProviderX ASN hop, lots of RX errors visible.

Priya: bgpd tail:
```
Mar 21 11:02:12 bgpd[2101]: neighbor 203.0.113.5 Reset (remote closed)
Mar 21 11:02:14 bgpd[2101]: received UPDATE nlri: 198.51.100.0/22 withdrawn
Mar 21 11:02:20 bgpd[2101]: neighbor 203.0.113.5 established
Mar 21 11:02:33 bgpd[2101]: BGP: update from 203.0.113.5: AS_PATH changed
```
pattern repeats every ~20s.

oncall-alex: ok looks like ProviderX session churn. Mitigation options: a) apply temporary inbound route-map to deprioritize flapping prefixes b) prefer ProviderY for EU egress via local-pref change c) open ticket with ProviderX NOC. I'll coordinate a + b in parallel. Priya/Jordan, prep config snippets.

Jordan: prepared export policy tweak to bump local-pref to ProviderY for affected EU RPKI-confirmed prefixes. Can push safely.

Priya: prepping an rx route-map to filter very-high-churn updates and apply dampening. Proposed snippet:
```
ip as-path access-list 100 permit _203_\nroute-map PROTECT_RX deny 10\n match as-path 100\n set local-preference 60
!
```
We'll apply rx-only on session to 203.0.113.5.

Samir: recommend also setting a conservative max-prefix and lowering hold-time temporarily? Might avoid memory thrash if withdraw storms continue.

oncall-alex: agree. Jordan, push local-pref change now for critical EU prefixes. Priya, apply rx route-map and dampening. Samir, prepare hold-time/max-prefix changes as last resort.

Jordan: pushed local-pref to prefer ProviderY for 198.51.100.0/22 and 203.0.114.0/23. BGP updates flowing out now. Monitoring for latency impact.

Priya: applied rx dampening for matching AS 203.0.113.5 with half-life 15m, reuse 750, suppress 3000 for the most flapping prefixes. Added as-policy on rx only.

providerx-noc: ProviderX NOC here. We are seeing intermittent hardware errors in our eu fabric causing session resets for some peers. Eng team investigating; ETA 20m. We'll post updates.

Marta: tracking customer impact: error spike for EU nodes. Creating incident ticket INC-2026-612. Notifying top affected accounts. Drafting status page blurb.

status-bot: DRAFT: "Investigating: Routing instability affecting a subset of EU traffic via ProviderX. Traffic being routed via alternate upstreams where possible. Expect intermittent request failures. Next update in 15 minutes." Approve?

oncall-alex: approve. Publish and tag support & #incidents.

Samir: after local-pref change, packet loss on probes dropped from ~12% to <1% for most targets. Some PoPs still show jitter — likely intra-provider fabric.

Priya: bgp logs show reduced withdraw frequency after dampening. Still seeing occasional short resets for a small set of prefixes.

providerx-noc: Update: identified faulty spine in eu cluster; replacement scheduled immediate. Sessions should stabilize after hardware swap (ETA ~15m).

oncall-alex: good. Keep dampening and alternate-provider preference in place until ProviderX confirms stable for 10+ minutes. Priya, keep RIB diffs collected for postmortem.

Marta: severity -> Sev2. Published status update, notified account owners, and legal/comms on potential customer escalations.

Jordan: telemetry: SLO burn rate for EU region spiked but is recovering after reroute. We'll keep reroute for 60 mins then re-evaluate.

Priya: replacement observed, BGP session re-established cleanly. bgpd log tail shows no withdraws for the last 3 minutes.

providerx-noc: Confirmed replacement complete; sessions stabilized. We'll monitor and follow up with RCA.

oncall-alex: plan: 1) keep preferences and dampening for 10 more minutes 2) staged rollback: remove dampening for non-flapping prefixes, then restore original local-pref 3) collect artifacts for postmortem and contact ProviderX for formal RCA. Priya please own the rollback.

Priya: ack. Will do staged rollback in 8 minutes if no regressions. I'll also open internal postmortem doc and attach bgp logs.

Marta: customer impact log updated: AcmeCorp ~4% error rate during window, FinSoft ~1.8%; created follow-up comms for account teams.

status-bot: Update posted: "ProviderX reports hardware replacement; sessions stable. Traffic returning to normal. Monitoring continues." Next update in 30m.

oncall-alex: thanks all. Handing off monitoring to Priya for the verification window. Closing note: root cause = ProviderX hardware failure causing session resets and withdraws; mitigations = inbound dampening + prefer ProviderY egress. Action items: update runbook with ProviderX playbook, review peer hold timers and prefix limits, coordinate postmortem w/ ProviderX.

Priya: ack and owning follow-up. Leaving channel open for 1 hour. :thumbsup:

(Reaction notes: multiple :eyes: and :thumbsup: throughout the thread)
